title: Banana - Green: modeled ₹783/qtl left, Kottakkal → Ernakulam
summary: January 2023: reported banana - Green prices at Kottakkal and Ernakulam imply a positive modeled margin after costs on 100% of 24 matched days; a morning-report back-test averages ₹783 per quintal. No actual trade verified.
why_selected: Selected from 342 same-variety market pairs screened for banana - Green in January 2023; best tested candidate among the bounded set of routed finalists, not a global optimum.

evidence.observations: daily modal prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) at both markets; sale matched to the first Ernakulam report 1–3 days after purchase
caveats: Back-test on reported prices: no actual shipment, buyer or seller is claimed.
Modal prices are reported daily aggregates, not offers anyone could be sure to get.
This data has no arrival volumes, so it cannot show whether the destination could absorb more supply; no capital-constrained or volume allocation optimum is claimed.

Costs extrapolate onion survey values (including to other crops) plus stated allowances, not freight quotes; OSRM car routing, not a verified truck route. Representative town points may not be at mandi gates.
Historical: this says what paid then, not what pays today.

scenes.headline: January 2023
scenes.caption: Kottakkal (Kerala) and Ernakulam (Kerala) both reported banana - Green prices for the same variety and grade (FAQ) on 24 matched days.

scenes.headline: Two markets, two prices
scenes.caption: Kottakkal reported a median ₹3,225 per quintal. Ernakulam reported a median ₹4,500 around modeled arrival days. These are not offers.

scenes.headline: Gap ₹1,150/qtl
scenes.caption: The median gap was ₹1,150 per quintal, and Ernakulam was dearer on 100% of days.

scenes.headline: 144 km by road
scenes.caption: 144 km on OpenStreetMap roads (~2 hours by car). A loaded truck is slower, so we allow 1 days plus 7 days to get paid.

scenes.headline: After modeled costs
scenes.caption: Freight ≈₹31/qtl, 5% fees and commission, loading, 5% loss and interest. On the typical day ₹729 per quintal was left.

scenes.headline: Still positive under stress
scenes.caption: With 25% dearer freight, 10% loss and costlier credit, the typical day still kept ₹504 per quintal.

scenes.headline: A trader who only knew the morning's news
scenes.caption: Using only the latest available Ernakulam report, the rule selects 24 of 24 modeled shipping days. 24 had positive modeled net, averaging ₹783 per quintal (₹550 under stress).

scenes.headline: The back-test
scenes.caption: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kottakkal to Ernakulam was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹78,300, or ₹55,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.

assumptions.value: onion survey freight applied per quintal to banana - Green
scaled by road km against the 1,115 km Lasalgaon→Azadpur route → ₹31/qtl here
12% a year (14% adverse) for transit + 7 days
~450 road km a day → 1 days here

conclusion: The modeled Banana - Green route from Kottakkal to Ernakulam was positive on 100% of matched days in January 2023. At that average, a 100-quintal (10-tonne) load implies ₹78,300, or ₹55,000 under stress. Actual buyer, capacity, haggling, rejection and delays are unknown.
